title: Check invertibility of the Codec 128-bit seed transformation
description: For fixed input blocks and tail, prove the paired hash updates and avalanche injective over 64-bit modular words. Characterize exactly when the signed and unsigned extensions of a 32-bit seed produce identical results. Bind all three original released classes and distinguish the theorem from the bounded JVM caller results.
expected: Bind each result to the exact caller, artifacts, profile and validation controls.
